status: Exploratory raster identity concepts. Dark styling is an intentional alternative to the source plan's warm direction. Names are not cleared trademarks or domains.

concepts.name: Nullkeel
concepts.why: Null + keel: minimal overhead above a steady underlying structure. A composed hacker identity built around precision and autonomy.
concepts.mascot: Nix, a graphite cuttlefish with a single cyan mantle seam
concepts.style: Stealth industrial design; deep matte charcoal surfaces; sharp cyan edge lighting; original sculptural cuttlefish rendered with beautifully simplified forms. Wide, lowercase neo-grotesk typography, sparse and precise. No holograms or busy HUD.
concepts.mark: An open N made from two offset keel-like strokes with a narrow channel between them, simple and bold.
concepts.scene: A composed cuttlefish in three-quarter view, streamlined dark body, readable eye, eight short relaxed arms gathered naturally and two subtle longer tentacles, one bright cyan seam around the mantle; not an octopus with random limbs. Wallpaper is an enormous dark flowing mantle shape with one cyan rim and abundant near-black negative space.
concepts.strength: Strongest restrained hacker identity; visually confident without needing heavy neon.
concepts.tradeoff: The darkness needs carefully separated surfaces so it does not hide controls.
